eligible_for_interpretation: non-dummy model repeatedly improves MAE or median absolute error over dummy median
Spearman is consistently positive across repeated splits
formula-group and chemical-system results do not collapse
screening metrics improve over tie-sensitive dummy baseline
catastrophic negative R2 folds are not dominant
model_eligibility_policy.diagnostic_only: Model may be useful for audit diagnostics but is not defensible for predictive interpretation.
model_eligibility_policy.not_eligible: Model is not a defensible predictive model for interpretation or recommendation.

representative_model_policy.reason: A representative model is selected only if the eligibility gate supports predictive interpretation across group-aware validation.

applicability_domain_method.imputation: median fitted on each train fold only
applicability_domain_method.scaling: StandardScaler-equivalent mean/std fitted on each train fold only
applicability_domain_method.test_distance: nearest train descriptor distance plus fixed k-nearest mean distance
applicability_domain_method.descriptor_seen_status: exact descriptor vector match against train fold

distance_metric.name: Euclidean distance after train-fold median imputation and scaling

subgroup_policy.small_group_handling: record row count and emit NaN where metric is not meaningful

explanation_policy.diagnostic_only_or_not_eligible: Do not run SHAP; do not present importance as physical explanation.
explanation_policy.eligible_for_interpretation: If ever supported, prefer held-out permutation importance stability across formula-group folds before SHAP.

allowed_claims: exact provenance dataset was acquired and validated
random split contains substantial descriptor/formula overlap
structure-free composition representation has identifiable limitations
deterministic descriptive screening of observed MP properties remains valid
prohibited_claims: accurate prediction of energy above hull
reliable discovery of novel stable materials

closeout_decision_rules.next_phase: v1.4 Smart Factory Process Quality Case Study

limitations: Descriptor distance is a diagnostic proxy, not calibrated uncertainty.
Composition-only descriptors do not encode crystal structure, synthesis route, or calculation settings.
Energy above hull values are computed Materials Project properties, not experimental outcomes.
Target strata are descriptive error-analysis strata and are not used for applicability-domain classification.
No candidate recommendation, active learning, phase diagram feature, or structure model is introduced.
